# GreeeeeeeeenText

GreeeeeeeeenText is a joke language being worked on by User:Areallycoolusername. All code is in the format of 4chans greentext memes. A hello world program looks like:

```
>be me
>says Hello world!
>*gets output*
```

A compiler where all code actually turns green is being worked on. (But maybe blue instead for copyright and stuff.)
